summary: An IC has no/incorrect footprint assigned. Detecting a true package↔footprint mismatch requires component-spec data; this example is detected via the missing-footprint rule. The rule engine confirms 5 finding(s).

confirmed_findings.title: Regulator missing input capacitor
confirmed_findings.detail: Regulator U2 (AMS1117-3.3) has no capacitor on its input net '+5V'. Most regulators oscillate or overshoot without it.
evidence: no capacitor attached to input net

confirmed_findings.title: IC without decoupling capacitor
confirmed_findings.detail: IC U2 (AMS1117-3.3) has supply pins without any decoupling capacitor to ground: pin 3 (+5V)
evidence: supply pin on '+5V' with no cap-to-ground on that rail

confirmed_findings.title: Net with only one connected pin
confirmed_findings.detail: Net '+5V' connects only U2.3. Check for a typo in a label or a missing wire.

recommendations.title: Fix for COMP-011
recommendations.detail: Add the datasheet-recommended input capacitor close to the pin (commonly 1–10 µF plus 100 nF; check the specific regulator's requirements).

recommendations.title: Fix for COMP-002
recommendations.detail: Assign the correct footprint before layout.
